correctness.rationale: All identities are reduced to iid Exp(1) spacings. The four I/B overlap classes have joint moments 1/9 and 5/24, so Cov(R,Q)=-n/36; T independent of (R,L) and E T=n yields Cov(R,L)=-1/36. Local-minimum pairs yield Var(R)=2n/45; adjacent exponential minima yield Var(Q)=5n/12 and E[T^2]=n(n+1) gives Var(L)=1/(6(n+1)). Exact Fraction enumeration of 5!,6!,7!,8! cyclic gap ranks independently confirms E R, Var R, E L and mixed covariance. No finite test substitutes for infinite-n proof.

value.rationale: The joint dependence of a structural component count and the directed network cost is natural in stochastic geometry, yet neither marginal statistic determines it. Exact independence of the raw sample size in the covariance is a nontrivial cancellation, and the limiting nonzero negative correlation reveals persistent motif–length dependence rather than mere two independent univariate moments. The result is specific, reproducible, and compares graph structure to spatial cost; no artificial parameter slice is introduced.
